sentences.text: 1  MFA No. 3551 of 2021

THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF M.V. ACT,
PRAYING TO CALL FOR THE ENTIRE RECORDS PERTAINING TO THE PROCEEDINGS IN MVC NO.823/2017, ON THE MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, UDUPI (SITTING AT KUNDAPURA) KUNDAPURA AND AFTER PERUSING THE RECORDS ENHCANE THE COMPENSATION BY MODIFYING THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 06.06.2020, PASSED THE MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, UDUPI (SITTING AT KUNDAPURA) KUNDAPURA, IN MVC NO.823/2017 AND AWARD JUST AND REASONABLE COMPENSATION CONSIDERING THE GRAVITY OF THE INJURY, PERMANENT DISABILITIES AND OTHER SURROUNDING CIRCUMSTANCES, WHICH IS PRODUCED AT ANNEXURE-A AND ETC.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR HEARING, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.

Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 06.06.2020 passed in MVC No.823/2017 by the Court of the Additional District Judge & Additional MACT, Udupi (Sitting at Kundapura),
Kundapura (for short 'the Tribunal'), the petitioner therein has preferred this appeal.

entities.text: Additional District Judge & Additional MACT, Udupi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. Brief facts of the case are as follows:
NC: 2023:KHC:29167 On 26.04.2017 at about 4.30 p.m. while the petitioner was t r a v e l i n g a s a p i l l i o n r i d e r o n m o t o r c y c l e b e a r i n g r e g i s t r a t i o n No.KA-20/NT009608/2016-17 met with an accident near Jannadi Bus Stand,
Haladi, Bidkalkatte Road, Kundapura Taluk with a lorry bearing registration No.KA-52/9399.
The accident happened due to rash and negligent driving of the lorry which was duly insured with respondent No.2 - Insurance Company.
4. The Tribunal has awarded global compensation of Rs.50,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till payment.
Not satisfied by the same, the petitioner has preferred this appeal.
5. The petitioner has suffered around 14 injuries to the body, though simple in nature and it required seven days hospitalization.

Under the circumstances, after arguing the matter for Sri. S M Sawood vs Sri. Nagaraj Dixit on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3423852/

sentences.text: sometime, both the learned counsel for appellant and respondent No.2 - Insurance Company submitted that it is just and proper to enhance the compensation by Rs.35,000/- (Rupees Thirty five NC: 2023:KHC:29167 Thousand only) globally without interest, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
6. Under the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem the same to be just and proper.
